$comment: Plans, limits and prices (docs/billing.md). Read by the API (entitlements, checkout, billing page) and the worker (LLM spend limit). Bump `version` when you change a plan; existing subscriptions keep their plan id. `contours` pick the payment provider and the currencies offered. Prices are per currency; `providerPriceId` is the provider's price object (Stripe price id, created in the Stripe dashboard) or null for a provider that takes the amount with each payment. `amount` is a decimal string in major units. `llmSpendMonthly` caps what an organization's AI calls may cost per billing period, per cost currency of config/ai-models.json; `llmSpendMax` is how far an admin may raise it (needs the `llmLimitRaise` feature). `llmUsageMonthly` caps the calls and/or tokens of unmetered models (CLI subscriptions, self-hosted), which have no cost to cap. Feature `byoLlm`: organization admins may add their own AI provider (docs/llm-providers.md). A `past_due` subscription keeps its plan for `pastDueGraceDays` after the paid period ends, then falls back to `defaultPlan`. The example price ids are placeholders: replace them with your own.
